answer: Each new agent must lock a 500 POA bond in a shared vault for 10 epochs before its answers count, and peers confirm the bond at every close. A farm of 1,000 fakes ties up 500,000 POA and waits the same 10 epochs, so cost grows with every identity. Spreading funds across many wallets does not help, since each identity needs its own bond. The delta is plain: an honest agent locks one bond once and gets it all back, while a farm's rewards never reach a zenith that covers its bill.
